key_reasoning.reason: Removal spans three distinct product areas: analytics (AIAdoptionTab, AnalyticsDashboard, multiple widgets and drill-down modals), settings administration (AiAdoptionConfigPage + 6 sub-components + test), and cross-cutting infrastructure (Valtio store, hook, util, types, router, constants).

31 files changed per diffstat (3742 deletions, 22 insertions). 11 files were fully deleted (AiAdoptionConfigPage, 6 admin sub-components, AIAdoptionTab, useAiAdoptionConfig hook, aiAdoptionConfigStorage util, ConfigSection test); the remaining 20 were modified to remove references. 31 files maps to XXL (16+) on the rubric scale.

No novel patterns or security/performance surface. Risk is primarily regression: 3742 lines removed across 31 files in three subsystems. Rollback is a clean revert. Scored M rather than S due to the breadth of the sweep and the risk of overlooked import references.
